thread:
Aria: quick heads-up — saw surge in partial stream deliveries + client timeouts on /v1/stream around 2026-03-22 02:12 UTC. opening follow-up to lock owners and timeline.
Ben: can you dump the sample request IDs and a short timeline? i'll pull traces.
Aria: sample reqs: rinf-9001, rinf-9002, rinf-9003. timeline shows deploy rollout 02:05-02:10, kube node kubelet reboots at 02:08, spike in client reconnects 02:10-02:14.
Zoe: pattern looks familiar — we saw similar after the last rolling deploy (different cluster) where server drain + client backoff caused truncated SSE frames.
Mateo: hypothesis: server-side early FIN during drain + clients' exponential backoff leads to missing token ranges. clients retry from start, causing dup + partial UI. need resume cursor and a short server-side resend buffer.
Aria: short-term triage proposals (quick owners):
- Add 'resume_cursor' field to stream handshake response so clients can resume where they left off — owner: Zoe — due: 48h
- Temporarily extend termination grace window on streaming workers from 3s -> 12s — owner: Mateo — due: canary in 6h
- Tag logs with metadata 'partial=true' and 'resume_hint' for any stream closed with incomplete final chunk — owner: Aria — due: EOD
- Create heatmap of client versions vs partial-rate during window — owner: Ben — due: tomorrow morning
sync-bot: Created task RINF-1902 (resume-cursor + telemetry) and assigned to Zoe / Aria / Ben.
Zoe: client-side incrementals: will add a resume step in JS/TS SDKs where client stores last-ack token index and on reconnect sends resume_cursor header. sketch in PR by end of week.
Mateo: server resend buffer idea: keep last N tokens per stream for 30s after close so a reconnect can request missing tail. small mem increase but helps UX. i'll prototype buffer with adaptive N=64 tokens. owner: Mateo. ETA 2 weeks for full rollout.
Ben: observability items:
- dashboard for partial-rate per-cluster, per-version, and per-deploy (5m rollup)
- alert: partial-rate > 0.4% sustained for 5m -> p1 page
owners: Ben / SRE. due: 3 days
Aria: Also add an event tracer that links reconnects to infra events (kube node drain, rollout id). Ben, can you correlate?
Ben: yes — i'll wire tracing spans and infra events into RINF-1902 timeline.
Zoe: SDK backoff baseline we should standardize across languages:
```
backoff(attempt) = clamp( jitter( base * 2^attempt ), min=200, max=20000 )
```
we'll add a 'resume-capable' opt-in flag for older SDKs.
Mateo: longer-term:
- RFC for 'resend buffer' & memory budget tradeoffs (Kai to review) — owner: Mateo — RFC due in 1 week
- Server: add reconnect reason codes surfaced to SDKs (REASON:DRAIN | REASON:NETWORK | REASON:BACKPRESSURE) — owner: Aria — draft by next Tue
- Product: decide if we treat partial streams as SLO failure or degradable UX (product discussion) — owner: PMs (TBD)
Aria: Action table I'll paste into RINF-1902:
- Aria: telemetry tags + paste timeline — due EOD
- Mateo: staging canary for drain grace change + resend buffer prototype — canary 6h, prototype 2w
- Zoe: SDK resume handshake + PR — PR by EOW
- Ben: dashboards + infra correlation — due in 3 days
Follow-up: 3/24 09:00 UTC — review canary metrics and decide roll to 25% prod. recurrence: biweekly postmortem check for 6 weeks (owner: Ben).
Ben: i'll own the biweekly cadence and add invite for SRE, SDK leads, and product.
Aria: thanks. i'll update the incident tracker and mark short-term owners in RINF-1902. please update the ticket when you start PRs/canary. :thumbsup:
